Name: Amazon Brand – Ravenna Home Heights Wood Lift Top Storage Coffee Table, 43.3"W, Espresso
Colors: Espresso
Materials: wood
Plywood with espresso walnut laminate and matte black-finished metal legs and hardware Top lifts up to reveal inside storage; shelf on bottom adds extra display space Wood/metal combo and straight lines blend with modern or industrial décor 15-30 minutes assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty. 23.6"L x 43.3"W x 15.7"H
